pattern.description: A row of orbs riding in white capsule tracks collapses: capsules shrink away and outer orbs shrink to dots while the centre orb scales up to become the sole focus, then a pixel-mosaic square glitches on over it.
pattern.why_premium: One continuous transform narrows attention from a many-voice equalizer to a single hero orb without a cut, and the pixel texture adds a material, tactile beat timed to the narration's 'tone, texture'.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.track', {scaleY:0, autoAlpha:0, duration:0.4, ease:'power2.inOut', stagger:{each:0.03, from:'center'}}).to('.orb:not(.hero)', {scale:0.1, autoAlpha:0, duration:0.4, ease:'power2.in', stagger:{each:0.04, from:'center'}}, '<').to('.orb.hero', {scale:3.5, duration:0.5, ease:'power3.out'}, '<0.15').fromTo('.mosaic-cell', {autoAlpha:0}, {autoAlpha:1, duration:0.05, ease:'steps(1)', stagger:{each:0.015, from:'random'}}, '>-0.1')
build_hint.remotion: Drive tracks and side orbs with interpolate(frame,[0,12],[1,0],{easing:Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic)}) on scale/opacity, staggered 1 frame from centre; hero orb scale via spring({damping:200, stiffness:120}) mapped 1 to 3.5; mosaic cells toggle opacity on random per-cell frame offsets (step, no interpolation).

notes: Camera verdict is none; the large scale sum reflects the hero orb growing, not a push-in. Pattern could alternatively be 'other' (orb collapse to hero); spotlight_focus chosen as closest.
